placements.why: Quinton establishes operational reliability standards around recurring verification of recovery and rollback mechanisms.
placements.title: Operational Capability Requires Active Verification
placements.frame: How does the organization ensure its recovery and failover mechanisms represent genuine operational capability rather than untested assumptions?

placements.title: Unrehearsed Rollback Is Not Actual Capability
placements.frame: How does regular live rehearsal determine the validity and existence of a system's rollback and recovery capabilities?
placements.why: Quinton asserts that an unrehearsed rollback procedure does not constitute a real capability, establishing a mandatory monthly rehearsal cadence for Atlas.
